# GET /api/v1/repos/{owner}/{repo}/git/trees/{sha}

Gets the tree of a repository by SHA hash with pagination support

**Module:** [routers](../modules/routers.md) · **Auth:** bearer · **ID:** `ep-246`

## Request

| Param | Location | Type | Required |
|-------|----------|------|----------|
| owner | path | string | True |
| repo | path | string | True |
| sha | path | string | True |
| recursive | query | boolean | False |
| page | query | integer | False |
| per_page | query | integer | False |

## Response

**200** — GitTreeResponse

| Field | Type | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `sha` | string | Tree object SHA |
| `url` | string | API URL for this tree |
| `tree` | []GitEntry | Array of tree entries |
| `truncated` | boolean | Whether more items exist after this page |
| `page` | integer | Current page number |
| `total_count` | integer | Total number of entries |

- **400** — SHA not provided or SHA not found in repository
- **404** — Repository not found

## Workflow

| Step | Module | Component | Type | Details |
|------|--------|-----------|------|---------|
| 1 | [routers](../modules/routers.md) | repo.GetTree | controller | Extract sha from path param; Call files_service.GetTreeBySHA |
| 2 | [services](../modules/services.md) | files.GetTreeBySHA | service | Get tree from git by SHA; List entries (recursive or not); Apply pagination; Build GitEntry array with URLs |

## Business Rules

| Rule | Category | Condition |
|------|----------|-----------|
| SHA parameter must be non-empty for tree retrieval | validation | len(sha) == 0 |
| Per-page limit capped at DefaultGitTreesPerPage (1000) | business_logic | perPage <= 0 || perPage > setting.API.DefaultGitTreesPerPage |

- **Tree not found by SHA** → repo.GetTree → 400

## ⚠️ Performance Issues

| Severity | Type | Description | Recommendation |
|----------|------|-------------|----------------|
| medium | unbounded_queries | ListEntriesRecursiveWithSize can return very large result sets for repos with many files | All entries are loaded into memory before pagination slice is applied. Consider streaming or limiting recursion depth. |

### Optimization Recommendations

- **[P2] pagination**: Apply pagination at git level rather than loading all entries first — *Impact: Reduce memory usage for large trees from O(n) to O(page_size)*
